name: Nocturnal-Barrow
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by bioluminescent seas. Farther poleward, past towering mountain ranges, the silence feels older than the soil.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in titanium here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
